Cottontail Rabbit.fact: Freezes, then bolts in a zigzag.

Gray Squirrel.fact: Freezes at danger, then darts up a tree.

Mourning Dove.fact: Feeds on open ground · Wings whistle in flight.

Bobwhite Quail.fact: Coveys burst from cover · Whistled bob-white call.

Raccoon.fact: Active at night · Often rests in hollow trees.

Groundhog.fact: Sits upright on watch · Dives into its burrow.

Prairie Dog.fact: Barks alarm calls across its burrow colony.

White-tailed Deer.fact: Snorts and flags its white tail when alarmed.

Wild Turkey.fact: Gobblers fan their tails, strut, and gobble.

Feral Hog.fact: Sows and piglets travel in groups called sounders.

Canada Goose.fact: Often flies in a honking V.

Mallard.fact: Hens quack · Drakes give a quieter rasp.

Green-winged Teal.fact: Dabbles in shallows · Flashes green wing patches in flight.

Red Fox.fact: Hunts mostly at night · Uses dens to raise young.

Coyote.fact: Yips and howls · Adapts to suburban life.

Mule Deer.fact: Stots when fleeing, pushing off with all four hooves.

Black Bear.fact: Usually avoids people · Can grow bold around food.

Ruffed Grouse.fact: Males drum from logs with rapid wingbeats.

Greater Sage-Grouse.fact: Males strut on leks and pop their chest sacs.

Sharp-tailed Grouse.fact: Males stamp their feet in a courtship dance.

California Quail.fact: Travels in coveys · Bursts into short flights.

Northern Pintail.fact: Tips tail-up to feed in shallow water.

Snow Goose.fact: Flies in huge flocks with near-constant calls.

Snowshoe Hare.fact: Turns white in winter · Wide feet help it travel on snow.

Bobcat.fact: Solitary ambush hunter · Often active around dusk.

Moose.fact: Wades to feed · One Alaska bull weighed about 1,700 lb.

Mountain Goat.fact: Rubbery hoof pads grip steep rock.

Bighorn Sheep.fact: Rams clash horns during the rut.

Dall Sheep.fact: Uses steep alpine rock as escape terrain.

Grizzly Bear.fact: Yellowstone males: 700+ lb · Alaska coast: up to 1,500 lb

Ptarmigan.fact: Turns white in winter for camouflage.

Chukar.fact: Runs uphill · Calls chuk-chuk on rocky slopes.

Gray Partridge.fact: Forages in coveys · Flushes with a noisy burst.

Bison.fact: Sweeps snow aside to graze · Bulls can reach 2,000 lb.

Muskox.fact: Herd forms a defensive ring around its calves.
